open_points.subject: REGISTRY_BASE_URL startup validation and ownership
open_points.text: R0-10 says, “The service is configured only by environment variables, which it validates when it starts,” while A6 says, “The service starts without it, and a Registry call made while it is missing or unusable fails as transport_error,” and A30 says it “is no required start-up variable.”
open_points.question: Does a missing or unusable REGISTRY_BASE_URL prevent startup, or may the service start and reject only Registry-dependent calls?
options: Startup succeeds; registry_gateway reads and validates REGISTRY_BASE_URL per call, returning transport_error when unusable.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the later, specific A6/A30 rule as authoritative: startup succeeds and only Registry calls fail.

witness.initial: The process environment has no REGISTRY_BASE_URL; all other required startup settings are valid.
events: The host operator starts the portal.
After startup, a caller invokes an operation requiring Registry validation.
outcomes: Under R0-10, runtime_settings refuses startup, so no caller can reach the service.
Under A6/A30, the service starts; the later Registry-dependent operation fails with RegistryFailureKind transport_error.
witness.observer: The host operator observes whether the service starts, and the API caller observes whether a running service returns a Registry failure.
